hypothesis: Point-in-time evidenced theme relationships and same-height competitors may improve non-one-word top-one promotion ranking; not yet demonstrated.
current_delivery: Verify existing sources and lock prospective evidence/field requirements before any performance comparison.

baseline.rule: Retain production model and original daily calls; register each future comparison model and input hash before labels mature.

cutoff_policy: Predeclare before each signal session; use only material and derived records actually available by cutoff. Collection late means unavailable; no rolling extension.
scope: Keep all candidates in the existing declared provider/mainboard/non-ST research roster. Provider coverage is not certified full A-share coverage.
signal_eligibility: Non-one-word status uses verified signal-day unadjusted OHLC under frozen rules, never target-day buyability.
required_inputs: Exact-date raw-reconstructed closing pool and all 2+ board candidates; preserve missing securities and official coverage limitations.
Signal-day theme membership/driver evidence with source bytes/hash, publication and actual capture times; current provider categories are descriptive only.
Frozen membership roster and overlapping themes; technical/performance labels cannot be interpreted as active business themes.
Boards and same-theme same-height/higher-board peer codes calculated inside declared roster; missing membership gives null, not zero.
Current baseline model scores, source files/hashes, ties and full candidate ordering saved before outcomes.
Next-official-session labels reconstructed independently only after target close.
strict_gates: Never mark provider categories as verified active themes.
Never synthesize V150 evidence or verified securities/full-market status to pass V114/V151.
Preserve all candidates, failed captures, unknown features and coverage.

performance_stage.primary_metric: Fixed daily non-one-word top-one next-session close promotion hit rate
performance_stage.comparison: Same sessions, roster and label rule; paired trading-day/block uncertainty, coverage, precision and complete-positive recall also reported.
performance_stage.sixty_percent: A target estimate only; 60 future signal sessions is an interim review, not proof of stability.
performance_stage.model_specification_gate: Exact features, algorithm, hyperparameters, training/validation boundaries and eligible sample policy must be registered before fitting or inspecting evaluation labels.

stop_condition: Readiness receipt completed or batch budget reached; do not train with unavailable theme truth.
next_step: Prepare source-bound future theme-role inputs compatible with V114/V151 using existing archives; retain null and unverified status rather than inventing fields.
